required_controls: NF06 source export SHA-256 must bind the exact record batch
manifest record/method aggregates must reconcile to the bound record batch
duplicate or malformed response_id values must fail closed
the supplied PROD collection frame must pass NF06 validation
manifest collection_frame_sha256 must bind the exact supplied collection frame
collection frame source_export_sha256 must bind the exact record batch
manifest and collection frame must reconcile channel-register and frozen-instrument hashes
every used recruitment_channel_id must be declared in the frozen collection frame
every record received_at must fall inside the frozen global collection frame
each recruitment_channel_id must exist in the frozen channel register
each record channel must be authorised for its region and audience
each record received_at must be within that channel's opened_at/closed_at window
primary_evidence_readiness must pass frozen population/channel/concentration rules
fail_closed_rules: primary_evidence_readiness alone does not authorise synthesis
a manifest plus source hash without the frozen collection frame does not authorise synthesis
global collection-window validity alone does not prove channel temporal provenance
missing or mismatched frame/hash/channel/temporal provenance blocks synthesis
PASS does not permit population prevalence, representativeness or causality claims
scope_boundary: This contract governs method/provenance eligibility only. It creates no evidence of need, no project-activity evidence, no population estimate and no permission to merge, deploy or activate PROD.
